newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RANGERS SIGN PERUGIA STRIKER NEGRI FOR $6 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RANGERS SIGN PERUGIA STRIKER NEGRI FOR $6 MILLION.

text.p: Scottish champions Rangers signed 27-year-old Perugia striker Marco Negri for 3.7 million pounds ($6.1 million) on Wednesday.
Negri is the fifth player to join Rangers from the Italian league in the last two months and brings their recent spending to well over 10 million pounds.
Defenders Lorenzo Amorouso and Sergio Porrini signed from Fiorentina and Juventus, joining young Perugia midfielder Rino Gattus and Roma's Jonas Thern.
Rangers beat off a late counter-bid from Napoli, impressed like the Scottish club by Negri's 33 goals for Perugia in the last two seasons.
Rangers manager Walter Smith said: "Marco will give us the cutting edge in Europe that we have been lacking."
